# Email: AcmeSystems Integration Decision

From: François Morel@acmesystems.example
To: Ibrahim Simon@acmesystems.example
Subject: AcmeSystems integration decision

Please confirm the API version before Thursday.

Reply: Version 2 is approved; Security will review the deployment plan.

Note: document interne AcmeSystems (version française de travail).
